The '''Loac system''' was located in the [[Hocatar sector/Legends|Hocatar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] operation known as the [[Loac Campaign]].<ref name="Cracken">{{JournalCite|10|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Loac [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA" />
